newProjectHelp: Validate and publish the event schema, then connect the SDK.
sampleNameHelp: Changes are kept only in this screen's memory and reset when you refresh.
nameLengthError: Enter a project name between 1 and 40 characters.
sampleContractHelp: Definition editing and real access management will connect after the server contract is finalized.
loadingHelp: Reading the current project settings from the server.
loadFailedHelp: Check the network or server status and try again.
accessHelp: Manage project access, server publishers, and change history.
projectSettingsHelp: Manage the project and its event collection environment.
readOnlyNotice: Connected with view access. Project owner access is required to change settings.
recoveryHelp: Your input was kept as entered. Saving is locked; review the latest settings and choose what to use.
basicInfoHelp: Manage the project's basic information and collection status.
statusHelp: Pausing stops new browser and server event collection.
allowedDomainsHelp: Only browser events from these domains are collected.
originsHelp: Enter one browser origin per line, up to 16. If empty, browser collection is blocked. This list does not apply to server publishing.
collectionLimitsHelp: Limit requests and new collection volume per project.
requestsPerMinuteHelp: An integer from 1 to 600: the maximum requests allowed per minute.
dailyReceiptLimitHelp: An integer from 1 to 1,000,000, reset by UTC date.
projectTimezoneHelp: The reference time zone for reports and events.
timezoneReadOnlyHelp: Set when the project was created and cannot be changed.
registryUnavailable: Registered events and workflows appear when the schema version is loaded with settings. This does not affect settings editing.
comparisonLabel: Compare the latest server settings with my input
confirmLoadVersion: Replace your current draft with the v{version} definition? The current draft will be lost.
schemaIntro: Publish event, property, workflow, and funnel definitions as a new version. Existing versions and aggregates remain unchanged.
schemaBlocked: Your draft was kept, but editing, validation, and publishing are locked. Check the server status and choose what to use.
schemaReadOnly: You can read registered definitions. Owner access is required to edit, validate, and publish.
schemaRecoveryLabel: Check schema conflicts and publication result
noPublishedSchemas: No schemas have been published. Create your first definition.
loadVersionHelp: Loading a version replaces the editor contents. Save your draft to a file before leaving if you want to keep it.
versionInputHelp: An integer greater than the latest version, up to 2,147,483,647.
schemaDefinitionHelp: Enter the events and workflows arrays and an optional funnels array. Set representativeWorkflowId to choose the representative workflow; publish a new version to change it. Define 1–50 events, up to 10 workflows and 10 funnels, and 2–10 funnel steps. Names use lowercase English letters, numbers, and underscores.
previewJsonHelp: The preview appears when the JSON is readable.
definitionValidationHelp: Checks JSON format, events, properties, and references.
privacyReviewed: I reviewed the definition and allowed values for personal data and raw input.
privacyReviewHelp: Automatic validation checks format and references. An administrator must review privacy manually.
versionsPreserved: Existing versions and aggregates remain unchanged.
switchSdkVersion: After publishing, switch the version used by the product SDK separately.
readyToPublish: Validation and privacy review are complete.
publishRequirements: Complete definition validation and privacy review to publish.
issueInvalidDefinition: Check required fields, data types, names, and allowed values.
issueDefinitionLimit: Check the limits: 1–50 events, up to 10 workflows and 10 funnels each, 2–10 funnel steps, and a 32KiB definition.
issueDuplicate: Event names, workflow IDs, funnel IDs, or funnel step events are duplicated.
issueCardinalityLimit: A property can have up to 32 values, and an event can have up to 256 possible combinations.
issueInvalidReference: Check that step events and sources are registered and that workflow step events do not overlap another workflow.
issueDimensionMismatch: Comparison properties must be required properties with the same data type and allowed values at every step.
propertyFormUnavailable: This property definition cannot be edited in the form. The JSON you entered was kept.
propertyLimitsHelp: Each property can have up to 32 allowed values, and an event can have up to 256 possible combinations. An optional property with no value counts as one combination.
combinationsIncomplete: Complete the allowed values and ranges to check the combination count.
combinationsExceeded: The possible combinations exceed 256. Reduce allowed values or properties.
noProperties: No properties yet. Add only the information needed to distinguish events.
purposePlaceholder: Example: compare completions by public file type
allowedValuesHelp: Start with a lowercase letter or number and use lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens. Each value can be up to 32 characters; blank lines and duplicates are not allowed.
propertyNameHelp: Names start with a lowercase English letter and are at most 48 characters. Define collection purposes and allowed categories instead of personal data or raw input.
propertyLockedHelp: This property is a workflow comparison property, so only its purpose can be edited. Edit linked definition changes together in JSON.
propertyTypeChangeHelp: Changing the data type resets the allowed values or range for that type.
integerRangeHelp: Integer range: −1,000,000 to 1,000,000 · up to 32 values
propertyAdded: Property added. Enter its name and collection purpose.
eventFormUnavailable: The JSON or event entries must be readable to edit them in the form. Your draft was kept as entered.
eventFormHelp: The name is the English identifier used in code; the display name appears in the admin screen. Expand a property section to configure it. Link workflows and funnels in the forms below.
noEvents: No events yet. Add an event, then validate the definition.
eventLinkedHelp: · Linked to a workflow or funnel, so its name, source, and removal are locked.
eventLimitReached: You can register up to 50 events.
eventAdded: New event added. Enter its name and display name.
workflowFormUnavailable: The JSON or workflow entries must be readable to edit them in the form. Your draft was kept as entered.
workflowFormHelp: A workflow connects browser events into start, success, and failure steps. Comparison properties must be required at every step. Warnings are guidance; server validation makes the final decision.
representativeWorkflowHelp: This workflow supplies the completion rate in service integration status and the service overview. It takes effect after you publish a new version. When unset, no completion rate is shown; Goals still queries every workflow.
representativeWorkflowWarning: The representative workflow ID does not refer to a unique workflow in this draft. Choose another workflow or clear the selection.
noWorkflows: No workflows yet. Add a workflow, then validate the definition.
workflowIdHelp: Starts with a lowercase English letter and is at most 48 characters. Use only lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores.
displayNameHelp: The name shown in the admin screen. Enter 1–80 characters.
failureReasonHelp: Choose one enum property from the failure event. After a new version is published, only the first failure reason is counted, distinguishing missing reasons from periods that were not measured.
failureReasonWarning: Choose an enum property from the failure event again or turn off reason tracking.
noDimensionChoices: Step events need required properties before comparison properties can be selected.
dimensionHelp: Only required properties with the same data type and allowed values at every step can be used for comparison. Select up to four; click a selected item again to clear it.
workflowLimitReached: You can register up to 10 workflows.
workflowAdded: New workflow added. Enter its ID and display name.
representativeRemoved: The representative workflow was removed, so the representative selection was cleared. You can choose another workflow.
representativeSet: Representative workflow selected in the draft. It appears in Overview after publication.
representativeCleared: Representative workflow selection cleared in the draft.
funnelFormUnavailable: The JSON or funnel entries must be readable to edit them in the form. Your draft was kept as entered.
funnelFormHelp: A funnel connects 2–10 steps of one journey in order. Browser and server events can be combined. Choose each step event only once per funnel.
funnelWindowHelp: Progress is counted within 24 hours of the first step. After publishing the definition, pass journey linkage data as described in the SDK connection guide so steps can be joined.
noFunnels: No funnels yet. Add a funnel, then choose its step events.
noFunnelDimensions: Required properties from step events can be selected as comparison properties.
funnelDimensionHelp: Up to four. Every step needs a required property with the same data type and allowed values. The current funnel analysis screen combines all property values.
warningsReferenceOnly: Warnings are guidance. The definition validation below makes the final decision.
funnelAdded: New funnel and two steps added. Enter a name and choose step events.
funnelStepAdded: New step added. Choose an event.
draftFileHelp: Choose a UTF-8 draft file saved by Tallyfin. Incomplete JSON and the version input are restored as saved. The file is read only in your browser; validate the definition and review privacy again after importing.
draftDownloadFailed: Could not create the draft file.
draftTooLarge: Choose a draft file of 128KiB or less.
draftReplaceCancelled: Draft replacement cancelled. Your current input and review state are unchanged.
draftImportChanged: The editor state changed, so the file was not imported. Check the state and choose the file again.
draftReadCancelled: File read cancelled. Your current input and review state are unchanged.
draftReadInterrupted: The editor state changed, so the file read stopped. Choose the file again.
draftReadFailed: Could not read the draft file. Choose it again.
confirmReplaceDraftWithFile: Replace your current draft with the file contents? The current draft and version input will be lost.
serverDraftHelp: This draft is shared by project owners. Store only definitions without personal data or secrets. Saving does not publish or reserve a version.
serverDraftFirstHelp: Check the server draft first, then you can save the current input. Nothing is saved or loaded automatically.
savingSelectedInput: Saving the selected input. Later edits must be saved separately.
serverSaveConfirmed: Confirmed that the current input is saved on the server.
laterEditsNotSaved: The requested input is on the server. Edits made since then are not saved yet.
serverDraftReviewRequired: Review the save result or another change. Check the server draft again and choose what to use. Saving is not retried automatically.
compareServerAndCurrent: Compare server draft with current input
keepCurrentAndReviewSave: Keep current input and review saving again
serverDraftLoadCancelled: Server draft load cancelled. Your current input and review state are unchanged.
currentInputKept: Current input kept. The next save will use the reviewed server draft as its basis.
serverDraftOwnerOnly: Only an owner who can edit can check, save, or load the server draft.
confirmUseServerDraft: Replace the current input with the server draft? The current draft and version input will be lost.
compareDefinitionsHelp: Compare two published definitions. Your draft does not change.
needTwoVersions: Two or more published versions are required to compare.
selectDifferentVersions: Choose two different versions. Versions not listed can be loaded with Load older versions above.
comparisonLocked: Comparison is available after the schema list and access are checked.
definitionLoadFailed: Could not load the definitions. Compare again.
comparisonSemanticsNotice: Definitions with the same name can measure different things when sources, allowed values, or steps change. This table does not judge compatibility and does not combine or calculate aggregates or conversion rates across versions.
scrollComparisonHelp: Scroll the table horizontally to see values from both versions.
comparisonCaption: Definition changes from base v{from} to comparison v{to}
sdkSchemaError: Could not load the registered schema. Check again.
sdkEmpty: Publish an active schema to generate connection code.
sdkBrowserOriginHelp: The service origin must be in the browser allowlist.
sdkServerAuthHelp: The server needs dedicated publisher authentication and project publish access. Browser allowed origins are not used.
sdkFunnelProfileHelp: The journey funnel profile collects general events and registered funnel steps, but not existing workflows. Remove workflow-only events from the schema; the default entry does not include funnel code.
sdkStandardProfileHelp: The general entry collects registered events and existing workflows as configured. Choose journey funnels only for services that also use them.
sdkServerFunnelHelp: Server code includes registered server funnels in the schema. Journey links are random journey metadata containing only funnelId, runId, and startedAt; they are not credentials. Publishing still passes dedicated publisher authentication and project access checks, and the server that completes the journey publishes the success step. The host must preserve the journey's classification values and each step's first occurrence time.
sdkBrowserFunnelHelp: Journey links are random journey metadata containing only funnelId, runId, and startedAt; they are neither credentials nor visitor identifiers. The host must preserve the journey's classification values and each step's first occurrence time, and pass the original occurrence time on manual retries. Server steps are published by the server after it confirms actual completion.
sdkBuildStep: The SDK is not yet distributed as a public package. In the Tallyfin repository, run npm run build:{source}.
sdkLinkStep: Connect the local package built in your service at packages/{source}.
sdkServerPackageNote: Do not put the server SDK or publisher token in the browser.
sdkFunnelPackageNote: Use the funnels entry (@tallyfin/browser/funnels) and do not put the server core in the browser.
sdkBrowserPackageNote: Do not put the server core in the browser.
sdkServerTokenStep: Pass a getToken function that obtains the publisher token from your real service to the connection code. Do not use an admin token.
sdkBrowserTokenStep: Enter the real collector origin below and use the connection code. Do not include an admin token.
originHelp: Do not assume this is the admin screen's address. Enter only the origin, without a path, query, or token.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the code below and copy it manually.
